title: Use a verified companion source repository
preconditions: The Saga and source are separate Git repositories and the Saga declares the source repository identity.

steps.action: Open equivalent and mismatched source checkouts through the repository verifier.
steps.expected_result: Equivalent transport forms are accepted and a foreign or unverifiable checkout is refused unless explicitly overridden.

steps.action: Author exact references at a selected source commit without a changed-line comparison.
steps.expected_result: The references are digested and stored against existing source without requiring a source change.

steps.action: Synchronize the companion Saga to the verified full source commit.
steps.expected_result: The Saga records the documented source cursor and refuses a redundant in-repository cursor.

steps.action: Change source and Saga history independently and open a comparison through the cursor.
steps.expected_result: Code deltas come from source history and documentation deltas come from the cursor-aligned Saga history.

expected_result: Companion observation and comparison use the selected verified source and an explicit synchronization cursor.
